etymology: From Antony Flew's example: no Scotsman puts sugar on his porridge - and any Scot who does is reclassified.
committed_when: A counterexample has just been produced against a generalisation about a group.
tell: The group acquires a new membership test, applied only to the case at hand.
counter: Fix the definition before the counterexamples arrive, and ask which rule excluded this one and why that rule was not mentioned earlier.
senses: Protecting a generalisation from counterexamples by redefining the category until the counterexamples fall outside it.
It works because definitions are genuinely negotiable. The sentence sounds like a clarification, and a clarification is much harder to argue with than a false claim.
example: *"No real conservative would vote for that."* The vote happened; the sentence has quietly moved the boundary so it cannot count against the brand.

confused_with.tell: The straw man weakens the opponent's claim; the Scotsman strengthens the speaker's, by shrinking the group until the counterexample is expelled.
